2026 Hyundai Ioniq 6 N Review - Crazy Performance & 1-Pedal Drifting!
There’s a new track weapon out of South Korea, Hyundai’s Ioniq 6 N, which finally will give the Tesla Model 3 Performance some proper competition. There aren’t many cars in this segment: high performance AWD electric mid-size sedans, without the lofty price tag of the more bonkers EV performers out there. The Model 3 Performance really has been in a league of its own for the past 7 years, but that all changes now thanks to the 2026 Hyundai Ioniq 6 N.
